items.name: Club
items.description: A length of hard wood. Cheap, legal to carry everywhere, and surprisingly effective.

items.name: Dagger
items.description: A short blade for close work and quick throws.

items.name: Greatclub
items.description: A two-handed slab of wood that hits like a falling tree.

items.name: Handaxe
items.description: A light axe balanced for both chopping and throwing.

items.name: Javelin
items.description: A throwing spear with a long iron head.

items.name: Light Hammer
items.description: A one-handed hammer light enough to throw.

items.name: Mace
items.description: A flanged head on a short haft, made for crushing armor.

items.name: Quarterstaff
items.description: A simple staff, and the most underestimated weapon on this list.

items.name: Sickle
items.description: A curved farm blade that found other work.

items.name: Spear
items.description: A versatile thrusting weapon, usable in one hand or two.

items.name: Light Crossbow
items.description: Slow to reload, but anyone can be taught to aim it in an afternoon.

items.name: Dart
items.description: A weighted throwing spike.

items.name: Shortbow
items.description: A compact bow suited to horseback and forest work.

items.name: Sling
items.description: A leather strap and a stone. Ancient and quietly lethal.

items.name: Battleaxe
items.description: A broad-bladed axe built for war rather than wood.

items.name: Flail
items.description: A spiked head on a chain; hard to use, harder to block.

items.name: Glaive
items.description: A heavy blade on a long pole, for keeping enemies at arm's length.

items.name: Greataxe
items.description: Two hands, one swing, one problem solved.

items.name: Greatsword
items.description: An enormous blade that trades finesse for terrifying reach and weight.

items.name: Halberd
items.description: Axe, spike, and hook on one pole. A tool for every kind of unpleasantness.

items.name: Lance
items.description: Devastating from horseback, awkward everywhere else.

items.name: Longsword
items.description: The classic knightly blade: balanced, versatile, and a status symbol.

items.name: Maul
items.description: A two-handed sledge that turns plate armor into a problem for the wearer.

items.name: Morningstar
items.description: A spiked ball on a haft. Punches through mail where a sword would skid.

items.name: Pike
items.description: An enormously long spear, best used shoulder to shoulder with others.

items.name: Rapier
items.description: A slender thrusting sword rewarding precision over strength.

items.name: Scimitar
items.description: A curved, light blade made for fast draw-cuts.

items.name: Shortsword
items.description: A stabbing blade favoured by scouts and anyone fighting in a corridor.

items.name: Trident
items.description: A three-pronged spear, common among coastal folk.

items.name: War Pick
items.description: A narrow spike designed to punch straight through plate.

items.name: Warhammer
items.description: A hammer on one side, a spike on the other, and no wasted motion.

items.name: Whip
items.description: Reaches further than any blade and disarms as easily as it wounds.

items.name: Blowgun
items.description: Silent, nearly harmless on its own, and the perfect delivery system for poison.

items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.description: Small enough to conceal under a cloak.

items.name: Heavy Crossbow
items.description: Slow, heavy, and capable of punching through a shield.

items.name: Longbow
items.description: Takes years to master and outranges everything else on the field.

items.name: Flametongue Longsword
items.description: Speak the command word and the blade sheathes itself in fire.

items.name: Frostbrand
items.description: A blade rimed with permanent frost that numbs whatever it touches.

items.name: Thunderstrike Maul
items.description: Each impact releases a clap of thunder audible for a mile.

items.name: Vampiric Dagger
items.description: A cursed blade that feeds a little of every wound back to its wielder.

items.name: Holy Avenger
items.description: A paladin's blade that burns the undead and steadies nearby allies.

items.name: Padded Armor
items.description: Quilted layers of cloth. Cheap, warm, and noisy.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: Boiled and shaped hide; the standard for anyone who needs to move.

items.name: Studded Leather
items.description: Leather reinforced with close-set rivets.

items.name: Hide Armor
items.description: Thick furs and pelts, crude but effective.

items.name: Chain Shirt
items.description: A mail shirt worn under clothing, concealable at a glance.

items.name: Scale Mail
items.description: Overlapping metal scales on a leather backing.

items.name: Breastplate
items.description: A fitted steel chest piece that leaves the limbs free.

items.name: Half Plate
items.description: Plate for the vital areas, mail for everything else.

items.name: Ring Mail
items.description: Heavy leather sewn with iron rings. Outdated but affordable.

items.name: Chain Mail
items.description: A full suit of interlocking rings with padding beneath.

items.name: Splint Armor
items.description: Vertical metal strips riveted to a leather backing.

items.name: Plate Armor
items.description: A full articulated suit. The finest protection money can buy.

items.name: Shield
items.description: A banded wooden shield strapped to the forearm.

items.name: Tower Shield
items.description: A wall you can carry, at the cost of ever moving quickly again.

items.name: Mithral Chain Mail
items.description: Mail forged from mithral: as strong as steel and light as cloth.

items.name: Dragonscale Plate
items.description: Plate faced with dragon scale, resistant to that dragon's element.

items.name: Elven Cloak
items.description: A shifting grey cloak that blurs the outline of whoever wears it.

items.name: Leather Helm
items.description: A padded cap with a reinforced brow.

items.name: Steel Helm
items.description: A full steel helm with a narrow visor slit.

items.name: Steel Gauntlets
items.description: Articulated plate gloves.

items.name: Steel Greaves
items.description: Plate protection for the shins and knees.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A red draught that closes wounds within seconds of drinking.

requiredMaterials.name: Sunblossom
requiredMaterials.description: A yellow flower that only opens at dawn.

items.name: Potion of Greater Healing
items.description: A deeper red brew for serious injuries.

requiredMaterials.name: Sunblossom
requiredMaterials.description: A yellow flower that only opens at dawn.

effects.name: Invigorated
effects.description: Restores a large amount of vitality.

items.name: Antitoxin
items.description: A bitter tincture that neutralises most common venoms.

items.name: Potion of Fire Resistance
items.description: Drinking it leaves the skin faintly cool to the touch.

requiredMaterials.name: Emberroot
requiredMaterials.description: A root that smoulders when crushed.

effects.name: Warded
effects.description: Flame does half its usual harm.

items.name: Oil of Sharpness
items.description: Applied to a blade, it holds an impossible edge for an hour.

effects.name: Keen Edge
effects.description: The coated weapon bites deeper than it should.

items.name: Potion of Invisibility
items.description: The drinker fades from sight along with everything they carry.

requiredMaterials.name: Ghost Mushroom
requiredMaterials.description: A translucent fungus from haunted ground.

items.name: Potion of Speed
items.description: The world slows to a crawl around the drinker.

requiredMaterials.name: Moonpetal
requiredMaterials.description: Blooms only under a full moon.

requiredMaterials.name: Phoenix Ash
requiredMaterials.description: Warm ash that never quite goes out.

effects.name: Hasted
effects.description: Move and act far faster than normal.

items.name: Basic Poison
items.description: A vial sufficient to coat one blade or three arrows.

requiredMaterials.name: Nightshade
requiredMaterials.description: The base of half the poisons in the world.

items.name: Alchemist's Fire
items.description: A sticky liquid that ignites the moment the flask breaks.

requiredMaterials.name: Emberroot
requiredMaterials.description: A root that smoulders when crushed.

items.name: Holy Water
items.description: Consecrated water, agony to fiends and undead.

effects.name: Consecrated
effects.description: Sears undead and fiends on contact.

items.name: Potion of Climbing
items.description: The drinker's hands grip stone as if it were a ladder.

items.name: Elixir of Health
items.description: Purges disease, blindness, and paralysis in one swallow.

items.name: Hempen Rope (50 ft)
items.description: Fifty feet of sturdy hemp rope.
items.overview: Fifty feet of sturdy hemp rope.

items.name: Torch
items.description: Burns for about an hour and lights a small room.
items.overview: Burns for about an hour and lights a small room.

items.name: Hooded Lantern
items.description: A shuttered oil lantern; the hood dims it to a narrow beam.
items.overview: A shuttered oil lantern; the hood dims it to a narrow beam.

items.name: Rations (1 day)
items.description: Dried meat, hard bread, and dried fruit for one day.
items.overview: Dried meat, hard bread, and dried fruit for one day.

items.name: Waterskin
items.description: Holds four pints when full.
items.overview: Holds four pints when full.

items.name: Bedroll
items.description: A padded roll that makes hard ground survivable.
items.overview: A padded roll that makes hard ground survivable.

items.name: Thieves' Tools
items.description: Picks, a small file, mirror, and narrow-bladed scissors.
items.overview: Picks, a small file, mirror, and narrow-bladed scissors.

items.name: Healer's Kit
items.description: Bandages, salves, and splints; ten uses before it runs dry.
items.overview: Bandages, salves, and splints; ten uses before it runs dry.

items.name: Crowbar
items.description: Grants leverage where leverage is what you need.
items.overview: Grants leverage where leverage is what you need.

items.name: Grappling Hook
items.description: Three iron prongs on a ring, best paired with rope.
items.overview: Three iron prongs on a ring, best paired with rope.

items.name: Holy Symbol
items.description: An emblem of a deity, used as a spellcasting focus.
items.overview: An emblem of a deity, used as a spellcasting focus.

items.name: Arcane Focus
items.description: A crystal-tipped rod used to channel arcane spells.
items.overview: A crystal-tipped rod used to channel arcane spells.

items.name: Component Pouch
items.description: A belt pouch of compartments for spell materials.
items.overview: A belt pouch of compartments for spell materials.

items.name: Spellbook
items.description: A blank leather-bound tome of a hundred vellum pages.
items.overview: A blank leather-bound tome of a hundred vellum pages.

items.name: Tinderbox
items.description: Flint, steel, and tinder for starting a fire.
items.overview: Flint, steel, and tinder for starting a fire.

items.name: Caltrops (bag of 20)
items.description: Scattered on the floor, they end a pursuit quickly.
items.overview: Scattered on the floor, they end a pursuit quickly.

items.name: Manacles
items.description: Iron wrist restraints with a simple lock.
items.overview: Iron wrist restraints with a simple lock.

items.name: Steel Mirror
items.description: A polished hand mirror, useful around corners and basilisks.
items.overview: A polished hand mirror, useful around corners and basilisks.

items.name: Ball Bearings (bag of 1000)
items.description: Spilled across a floor, they make it treacherous.
items.overview: Spilled across a floor, they make it treacherous.

items.name: Climber's Kit
items.description: Pitons, boot tips, gloves, and a harness.
items.overview: Pitons, boot tips, gloves, and a harness.

items.name: Thunderkiss
items.description: Balthazar's lute, rebuilt out of whatever survived the alchemist's accident. It is genuinely a fine instrument. It also converts a held chord into a directed detonation, which is why nobody sits in the front row twice.

items.name: Silvan's Hunting Sword
items.description: A mid-length hunting sword with a dark wood grip, given by a father who said almost nothing. Small marks are scratched along the blade - a private teaching language that nobody else can read.

items.name: Rhaz, the Horn Hammer
items.description: A war hammer cut from the horn of Raaz, the rhinoceros Vaerak found dying and did not let die. One end (the horn's base) is blunt, the other (the tip) is a point. Raaz's spirit lives in it - and in the charging-rhino tattoo on Vaerak's right hand. Partial summon: Raaz Horn Strike / Uppercut (10 HP per hit). Full summon: Summon Raaz.

items.name: Kaavor, the Sinew Lash
items.description: A tough whip braided from Kaavor's talons, with the falcon's claws woven into its length. Kaavor's spirit lives in it - and in the diving-falcon tattoo on Vaerak's left hand. It opens unarmoured flesh and keeps it bleeding, but it will not cut metal. Partial summon: Kaavor Talon Lash (5 HP per hit). Full summon: Summon Kaavor.

items.name: The Sixfold Judgment
items.description: A six-shot revolver of black steel and silver, faint violet runes along the barrel. It is bound to the Gravitic Anchor Node implanted along Kael's spine, which charges each loaded Sixfold Cartridge with condensed gravity. Every shot burns 1 chamber of charge (1 mana, regained on rests) AND 1 Sixfold Cartridge from the pack. Cartridges are never restored by resting: they must be looted, bought or crafted. Choose one effect per shot: Gravity Round (force instead of piercing), Crushing Shot (Strength save or prone), Singularity Round (1/short rest, pulls creatures within 3 m to the target), Anchor Round (1/long rest, Strength save or speed 0).

items.name: Monokatana
items.description: A single-edged blade honed to a width the eye keeps losing. It came through the change unaltered, which Kael finds more unsettling than anything that did change.

items.name: Gorlok's Giant Axe
items.description: Stolen from giants. Three times too large and three times too heavy for the goblin carrying it, which has never once been relevant. He killed the giants with it on the way out.

items.name: Looted Dwarven Heavy Armour
items.description: Dwarf-forged heavy plate, taken off its previous owner by hand and by force, then torn and rebent until it fit something a great deal shorter and a great deal wider.

items.name: Silvan's Leaf Pendant
items.description: A leaf-shaped pendant cut from ordinary forest stone on a woven cord, made by his mother and straightened by her at the gate. He touches it when he is anxious and has nearly worn the edge smooth.
items.overview: A leaf-shaped pendant cut from ordinary forest stone on a woven cord, made by his mother and straightened by her at the gate. He touches it when he is anxious and has nearly worn the edge smooth.

items.name: Gravitic Anchor Node
items.description: A spine of arcane cores running along Kael's back. It was a military combat implant in a world that no longer exists. It now lets him bend his own gravity, feeds the Sixfold Judgment, and feels to him like technology and magic are two words for the same thing. Grants Gravitic Shift and stores the Sixfold Judgment's six rounds (tracked as mana).
items.overview: A spine of arcane cores running along Kael's back. It was a military combat implant in a world that no longer exists. It now lets him bend his own gravity, feeds the Sixfold Judgment, and feels to him like technology and magic are two words for the same thing. Grants Gravitic Shift and stores the Sixfold Judgment's six rounds (tracked as mana).

items.name: The Word 'Lavenos'
items.description: A page torn from a book of a dead language, bearing one word: lavenos - suppleness, freedom, and an old exalted form of address whose original subject nobody remembers. A young noblewoman read it aloud once and made it his name.
items.overview: A page torn from a book of a dead language, bearing one word: lavenos - suppleness, freedom, and an old exalted form of address whose original subject nobody remembers. A young noblewoman read it aloud once and made it his name.

items.name: Ladies' Blade
items.description: A slender rapier with a lady's ribbon on the hilt. No bonus to hit, 1d6 piercing. On a hit look at the damage die: even → damage is doubled, odd → damage is halved (rounded up).

items.name: Forgotten Blade
items.description: An old blade nobody remembers forging, still keen. +3 to hit, 1d8 slashing. With the Ladies' Blade in the other hand: Dual Blade Strike (+5 to hit, 1d8 + 1d6).

items.name: Explorer's Pack
items.description: Backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, 10 torches, 10 days of rations, waterskin and 15 m of hempen rope.
items.overview: Backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, 10 torches, 10 days of rations, waterskin and 15 m of hempen rope.

items.name: Simple Clothes
items.description: Plain, sturdy travelling clothes.
items.overview: Plain, sturdy travelling clothes.

items.name: Visage (glasses)
items.description: A pair of elegant glasses called Visage. While worn: advantage on one Investigation or Perception check per short rest to spot a detail on a face or a page.
items.overview: A pair of elegant glasses called Visage. While worn: advantage on one Investigation or Perception check per short rest to spot a detail on a face or a page.

items.name: Philter of Love
items.description: A rose-pink philter. The next creature the drinker sees within 10 minutes charms them for 1 hour (DC 13 Wisdom save negates). Single use.

effects.name: Lovestruck
effects.description: Charmed by the first creature seen after drinking.

items.name: Dust Powder
items.description: A pouch of fine blinding dust. Thrown at a creature within 1.5 m: DC 12 Constitution save or blinded until the end of its next turn. 3 uses.
items.overview: A pouch of fine blinding dust. Thrown at a creature within 1.5 m: DC 12 Constitution save or blinded until the end of its next turn. 3 uses.

items.name: Advantage: Wisdom
items.description: A clear, cold draught that steadies the mind: advantage on the next Wisdom check or Wisdom saving throw made within 1 hour. Single use.

effects.name: Clear Mind
effects.description: Advantage on the next Wisdom check or save.

items.name: Null Monet
items.description: A blank coin. Flip it (action) and roll 1d6: 1-2 heal 2d6 HP, 3-4 take 2d6 force damage, 5-6 teleport up to 9 m to a random unoccupied spot you can see. Once per long rest.
items.overview: A blank coin. Flip it (action) and roll 1d6: 1-2 heal 2d6 HP, 3-4 take 2d6 force damage, 5-6 teleport up to 9 m to a random unoccupied spot you can see. Once per long rest.

items.name: Sixfold Cartridge
items.description: A brass revolver cartridge etched with a spiral gravity-glyph. Sixfold Judgment fires one with every shot. Rests do not bring cartridges back: they must be looted, bought, or crafted (brass casing + black powder + a pinch of anchor-dust at a workbench).
items.overview: Ammunition for Sixfold Judgment. Found or crafted only.

items.name: Tinker's Tools
items.description: Drivers, tweezers, tiny files and spare screws for clockwork and small mechanisms.

items.name: Smith's Tools
items.description: Hammers, tongs and punches for metal fittings, rivets and ammunition casings.

items.name: Woodcarver's Tools
items.description: Knives, gouges and a small saw for stocks, housings and frames.

items.name: Tinkerer's Portable Forge
items.description: A suitcase forge with a pressure boiler. Burns fuel to fill Steam-pressure charges (level 1).

items.name: Valebrick Portable Field Workshop
items.description: Toren's 32-36 kg backpack workshop: tool panels, a compact hardened-steel anvil, a small forge chamber, sealed blueprint tubes and the Valebrick Resonance Core - a refined crystal in a brass stabilisation cage. Deploys into a workbench in 30-60 seconds. Its furnace burns any fuel to fill Steam-pressure (L1) and Thermal (L2) charges; upgrades will unlock Electric charges and beyond.

items.name: Firewood Bundle
items.description: Dry split logs. Cheap and everywhere, but burns fast: 2 furnace units.

items.name: Charcoal Sack
items.description: Clean, hot-burning charcoal: 3 furnace units.

items.name: Coal Lump
items.description: Dense black coal from the mines: 4 furnace units.

items.name: Flask of Lamp Oil
items.description: Refined oil; the most efficient common fuel: 5 furnace units.

items.name: Brass Scrap
items.description: Offcuts, old fittings and casings - the basis of most housings.

items.name: Steel Bar Stock
items.description: Short bars of good steel for bolts, rams and frames.

items.name: Copper Wire Coil
items.description: Conductive wire for triggers, coils and shock circuits.

items.name: Clockwork Springs
items.description: A tin of springs, cogs and escapements.

items.name: Glass Lens
items.description: A ground lens or vial - focuses light or holds a reagent.

items.name: Leather Straps
items.description: Buckles and straps to mount a device on a body or a pack.

items.name: Alchemical Salts
items.description: Reactive salts: smoke, foam and flash compounds.

items.name: Black Powder
items.description: A small horn of powder. Keep it away from the furnace.

items.name: Valebrick Bolt Repeater
items.description: Single-barrel stationary turret carried in Toren's workshop pack (Artillerist Eldritch Cannon - Force Ballista). Deploy with an action on a small tripod within 5 ft; fire it with a bonus action: ranged attack, 30 m, 2d6 force and the target is pushed 5 ft. AC 8, HP 12; Mending restores 1d6. Basic rivet shots are free; special ammunition (Scalding or Concussion bolts) adds its own shot.

items.name: Smoke Canister
items.description: Pull the pin and throw: a 15 ft cloud of thick grey smoke heavily obscures the area for 1 minute. Consumed on use.

items.name: Tripwire Alarm
items.description: A spring-loaded bell with 15 m of copper tripwire. Anything crossing the wire rings it loudly; set up in 1 minute around a camp or doorway. Needs no charge.

items.name: Steam Grapnel Launcher
items.description: Wrist-mounted grapnel with 18 m of line. Each shot vents one Steam-pressure charge and can pull you up to the hook or yank a light object to you.

items.name: Sticky Foam Flask
items.description: A pressurised flask of expanding foam. Thrown 6 m, it glues a creature's feet in place (restrained, STR save DC 13 ends it). Consumed on use.

items.name: Clockwork Messenger Beetle
items.description: A palm-sized brass beetle in the style of Argus the owl. Wind it with one Steam-pressure charge and it carries a 25-word message to a place you know within 1 mile, then waits there.

items.name: Scalding Bolt
items.description: Bolt Repeater ammunition with a boiling-water core. Fires as a Bolt Repeater shot: 2d6 fire and the target is scalded (burn). One bolt per shot.

items.name: Flash Bomb
items.description: A glass ball of magnesium salts. Thrown 9 m, it bursts in a 10 ft blinding flash (1d4 radiant, CON save or blinded until the end of its next turn). Consumed on use.

items.name: Shock Dart
items.description: A finned dart with a charged copper coil. Thrown 9 m: 1d8 lightning and the target is shocked. Consumed on use.

items.name: Steam-Jet Gauntlet
items.description: A brass gauntlet with a pressure valve. Vent one Steam-pressure charge: 15 ft cone, 2d6 fire and the targets are pushed back.

items.name: Thermal Grenade
items.description: A thick brass shell holding a Thermal charge that is released all at once. Thrown 12 m: 10 ft radius, 3d6 fire and burning. Consumed on use.

items.name: Pressure Ram
items.description: A steel forearm piston driven by a Thermal charge. Melee: 3d8 bludgeoning, the target is knocked back and prone.

items.name: Concussion Bolt
items.description: Bolt Repeater ammunition packed with powder. On impact it bursts in a 5 ft radius: 3d6 thunder and the target is concussed. One bolt per shot.

items.name: Blueprint: Smoke Canister
items.description: Cover for a retreat or a hidden approach. No charge needed to build or use.

items.name: Blueprint: Tripwire Alarm
items.description: Camp security. No charge needed to build or use.

items.name: Blueprint: Steam Grapnel Launcher
items.description: Built once (needs a Steam-pressure charge to seal the boiler); each shot costs one more.

items.name: Blueprint: Sticky Foam Flask
items.description: A Steam-pressure charge pressurises the flasks; using them needs no charge.

items.name: Blueprint: Clockwork Messenger Beetle
items.description: No charge to build; each flight costs a Steam-pressure charge.

items.name: Blueprint: Scalding Bolts
items.description: Bolt Repeater ammunition. A Steam-pressure charge seals the boiling cores.

items.name: Blueprint: Flash Bomb
items.description: No charge to build or use.

items.name: Blueprint: Shock Darts
items.description: A Steam-pressure charge winds the coils; throwing needs no charge.

items.name: Blueprint: Steam-Jet Gauntlet
items.description: Built once; each blast costs a Steam-pressure charge.

items.name: Blueprint: Thermal Grenade
items.description: Each pair stores a Thermal charge (or stronger). Throwing needs no charge.

items.name: Blueprint: Pressure Ram
items.description: Built once; each strike costs a Thermal charge.

items.name: Blueprint: Concussion Bolts
items.description: Bolt Repeater ammunition. A Thermal charge primes the powder.

items.name: Valebrick Folding Bracer
items.description: A metal bracer covering the whole left forearm. With a flick it unfolds into a round light shield, 25 cm in radius. Stops arrows, bolts and light blades, but it is too light to absorb blunt blows (no bonus against bludgeoning). DM item - found in the storage world.

items.name: Thermal Smoke Grenade
items.description: A reusable brass canister with a heating coil and a cartridge of smoke salts. Slot in a Thermal capsule and throw: the coil flash-boils the salts into a 20 ft cloud that heavily obscures the area for 1 minute; then pick it up and reload it. Tuned to Thermal capsules ONLY - steam pressure cannot heat the coil and an Electric capsule would burn it out.

items.name: Blueprint: Thermal Smoke Grenade
items.description: Reusable smoke grenade. Building it needs no charge, but every throw needs exactly one Thermal capsule.
